title: Gotthard Tunnel proof of concept scan

tellings.quote: this is the final proof of concept, the Gotthard Tunnel.

plain: A 2024 scan of the Gotthard Tunnel, a very long railway tunnel through the Swiss Alps, is said to be the final proof that a scanning method linked to the researcher Filippo Biondi can see deep underground structures. The researcher Jeffrey Drum presents it as the test case, calling it "the final proof of concept, the Gotthard Tunnel," because the same method is used to claim that a vast energy network lies beneath the pyramids of Egypt.
